parts.t: Quality custom built home with all the extras in High Point Equestrian Estates. This private half acre home features a elevator for easy access to all 3 levels, chefs kitchen with Wolf/Sub Zero appliances & butler kitchen/pantry. Grand floor to ceiling custom wood windows through out. Overlooking serene koi pond, swim spa, hot tub & covered area for bbq & gas fireplace. Mbdrm with vaulted ceilings & large balcony. Amazing ensuite, complete with two massive walk in closets & dressing area. Walk out basement, hot yoga studio, theatre, wine room with chiller & wet bar. Over 1000 sq ft garage. Back up generator. Many new upgrades inc Washer & Dryer, outdoor sauna, projector & screen, Control 4 home automation control, security cameras, large storage shed, freshly painted exterior.
